blind.description: A classic golden royal crown or coronet consisting of a smooth circular base band studded with alternating round red and green jewels, topped with stylized fleur-de-lis peaks. The geometry is continuous, clean, and solid, rendered in a reflective metallic gold material with smooth polished surfaces.
blind.from_above: A circular gold ring with outward-facing decorative points and an open center, casting a cast shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4 to 5 inches tall and about 8 to 9 inches in diameter, roughly 1/15th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: Height is slightly squatter than catalog ratio but matches a realistic coronet proportion
